text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 45 vials of idarubicin hydrochloride 1 mg/mL, 20 mL with a daily use of 3.6 vials, providing 12.6 days on hand as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include idarubicin hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately 12.6 days. The rule-based best option is to purchase from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today. Hikma's label names no plant that could be placed for supply verification.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place order with Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. — requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to confirm receipt timeline and update inventory projection — requires buyer approval.
3. Pharmacy director to review supply adequacy after order confirmation — requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or alternative sourcing at this time.
